decisions.reason: The yogurt on mango mousse won the eathealthy Award, so its results are above aspiration and there is no shortfall that would trigger search for other uses of its resources.
The new Abendbrotkäse is featured on the home page as a flagship launch, which signals management commitment, and as a young organic cheese line it can be carried while results remain uncertain.
The semi-hard cheese wheel fits Söbbeke's core organic cheese range and gets only a plain mention, but there is no evidence of a performance shortfall large enough to prompt dropping it.
The spicy cheese is a niche variety with only a website mention, which makes it somewhat vulnerable, yet the established dairy business provides slack to keep it for another year.

Monsieur Jean Bernard mild creamy soft cheese was presented as rounding off the new soft cheese range, so it is part of a deliberate line extension that management is likely to keep while it builds sales.
The washed-rind soft cheese is a specialty item with uncertain demand, but it belongs to the new soft cheese range and has no reported shortfall, so it is likely to stay.
